note: Media Twitter is a glue submodule over contrib media_entity_twitter. hook_media_source_info_alter() sets $sources['twitter']['input_match'] = ['constraint' => 'TweetEmbedCode', 'field_types' => ['string','string_long']], preview => TRUE and forms.media_library_add => Drupal\lightning_media\Form\AddByUrlForm::class, then Override::pluginClass() swaps in the input-matching Twitter source. It also implements hook_theme_registry_alter() to repoint the media_entity_twitter_tweet theme hook at this module's templates/ directory and a preprocess hook that injects media_entity_twitter's twitter.png (180x180) as a 'placeholder' variable so embedded tweets are visible in CKEditor. No routes, permissions, services, settings form (configure = null), config schema, Drush or plugin types. config/install ships media.type.tweet (source twitter, source field embed_code - an instance of the parent module's shared media.embed_code storage), field_media_in_library and the form/view displays.

evals.prompt: What media source plugin and source field does the Tweet media type installed by lightning_media_twitter use, and which module actually provides the source plugin?
evals.expected_output: The media type media.type.tweet uses the 'twitter' media source provided by the contrib media_entity_twitter module, with the source field embed_code - an instance of the media.embed_code string_long field storage that Lightning Media itself installs and shares with the Instagram media type.

evals.prompt: Why does lightning_media_twitter implement hook_theme_registry_alter(), and what visual difference does it make when a tweet is embedded in CKEditor?
evals.expected_output: hook_theme_registry_alter() repoints the media_entity_twitter_tweet theme hook at lightning_media_twitter's own templates/ directory (only when it still points at media_entity_twitter/templates). The accompanying preprocess hook renders media_entity_twitter's twitter.png icon (180x180) into a 'placeholder' variable, so an embedded tweet shows a recognisable placeholder image inside CKEditor instead of nothing.

evals.prompt: How does lightning_media_twitter give editors a live preview of a tweet while they type, and how does it add an 'Add via URL' option to the media library?
evals.expected_output: Its hook_media_source_info_alter() sets $sources['twitter']['preview'] = TRUE (which makes Lightning Media's MediaForm add an AJAX-refreshing preview element, gated by MediaHelper::isPreviewable()) and $sources['twitter']['forms']['media_library_add'] = Drupal\lightning_media\Form\AddByUrlForm::class, which core's media library uses as the add form for that source.

evals.prompt: A media type on this Drupal site is labelled 'LM Tweet Embed'. Inspect the running site and tell me its machine name, the media source plugin ID it uses, and the machine name of its source field.
evals.expected_output: Machine name tweet, source plugin twitter, source field embed_code.

evals.prompt: Inspect the live field configuration of the Tweet media type on this Drupal site. What label do editors currently see for its source field, and is that field required?
evals.expected_output: field.field.media.tweet.embed_code currently has the label 'LM Tweet URL' and is required.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, rename the Tweet media type so that its human-readable label is 'Curated Tweet', and change its configuration so that newly created tweet items are hidden from the media library by default (use the field Lightning Media attaches for that).
evals.expected_output: media.type.tweet label is 'Curated Tweet' and the FieldConfig field.field.media.tweet.field_media_in_library has its default value set to 0/FALSE.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, add a media reference field with the machine name field_lm_tweet to the Article content type. It must reference media entities, be restricted so that only Tweet media items (the bundle installed by lightning_media_twitter) can be selected, and use the Media library widget on the default form display.
evals.expected_output: field.storage.node.field_lm_tweet of type entity_reference with target_type media, field.field.node.article.field_lm_tweet whose handler_settings.target_bundles is exactly ['tweet'], and a media_library_widget component for it on core.entity_form_display.node.article.default.
